remarks: Stunning and spotless updated three level townhouse with all new flooring and freshly painted throughout. This townhouse is located in the most convenient location within minutes of downtown shops/restaurants, train station and I-95. Step inside to the foyer and immediately notice the bright open floor plan with updated Eat-in Kitchen featuring stainless appliances, new countertops and glass tile backsplash. The Kitchen has an open view to the bright open concept Dining/Living Room with engineered wood floors and recessed lights which is the perfect space for entertaining and family gatherings, plus there are sliders to a private deck. in addition an updated powder room which completes the main level. Venture upstairs to view the ample Primary Bedroom with a wall of closets and branded new sparkling primary full bath with large walk-in shower. The spacious second bedroom also has a wall of closets and easy access to the updated hall full bath. The lower level includes a family room/home office/gym combo with the same new engineered wood floors plus a laundry/mud room with exterior door and access to your private 1 car garage. There is additional storage in the garage and attic. This townhouse also has one reserved parking spot in the complex lot and lush gardens in the center courtyard. This home must be seen to be appreciated!
